record another model's inference as something the client said
apply a decision from anyone not on the approvers list

act on a proposal, a rejected item or a superseded one
read memory by a client's name or phone number instead of the client id on the job
let the review fix anything it finds

who is on the approvers list
deciding between two instructions that contradict each other
acting on every item the review flags

checks.title: An agent proposes; it never writes an approved item
Only a decision by an authorised person changes a proposal, and the record says who and when
An approved item is never overwritten: a change is a new version, and the old one holds until it is approved
Every other standard reads the approved slice by the client id on the job, never by name or phone
A critical standing instruction is read fresh and followed on every later interaction
A review lists every approved standing instruction, flags drift, and changes nothing
